title: Backward iterates of the reflection centre are given by the conjugacy with the inverse map
author: Przemyslaw Berk; Frank Trujillo
work: Ergodic properties of infinite extension of symmetric interval exchange transformations
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 530-545: under the assumption that the first m iterates of a centre avoid the endpoints, the minus-m-th iterate of that centre is obtained by applying the reflection to a shifted iterate, the shift being given by the indicator of the case where the index is one half. The proof (source lines 547-549) is short but it depends on two observations that the statement does not contain: the hypothesis is exactly what makes the points of the computation points of continuity of the reflection and of its inverse, and the case distinction between the centre of the whole interval, which the reflection fixes, and the other centres, which the reflection sends to their first iterate, is what produces the indicator in the formula.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the labelled lemma, retained line for line

contexts.label: eq:generalized_conjugacy (the numbered conjugacy identity for iterates) retained as context: the counted proof applies it at source line 548
